instruction: Candid cinematic medium shot of an outdoor backyard garden. On the left, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands holding a wooden bat, smiling while blindfolded with a peach bandana. The man in the patterned t-shirt (R3), wearing glasses, stands behind her on the right, adjusting and tying the blindfold. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene against a lush green foliage background.
